features: The Groundbreaking New Sound - Latest wireless over ear Bluetooth headphones from CMF by Nothing, Headphone Pro, Features LDAC and Dual Hi-Res Certification. with customized 40mm dynamic drivers to deliver a more remarkable listening experience than ever before

Broad Compatibility, Simple to Use - An ideal headphone choice for iOS and Android, it supports various streaming devices via Bluetooth pairing or AUX and is also compatible with macOS & Windows. With built-in Google Fast Pair & Microsoft Swift Pair, it is ready to use right out of the box for most

Less Noise, Purer Sound - Experience up to 40 dB of Adaptive Active Noise Cancellation that elevates your listening experience and immerses you more fully in the music. Need to hear ambient sound? Just press the ANC button to toggle Transparency Mode instantly

All-Day Endurance and Comfort - Enjoy up to 50 hours of non-stop ANC-on wireless playtime, Our over-ear headphones featuring memory foam earpads and a cap-friendly headband that offer all-day comfort and stylish portability, from a quick podcast to hours of deep focus..

Built For Your Unique Style - Featuring Personal Sound Profile & CMF Spatial Audio. Why settle for standard sound? Explore your own concert/cinema-level experience for each listening session. Customizable via the Nothing X app
description: Experience unparalleled sound enjoyment and maximum freedom with the CMF by Nothing Headphone Pro, featuring up to 100 hours of playback time – your sound accompanies you all day long without compromise. Feel the power of every beat and immerse yourself in a sound world that evokes emotions and captivates you. The hybrid, adaptive ANC technologies ensure tranquility in any environment, while the dynamic 40mm driver delivers precise sound and rich bass. With innovative features like the 6-band equalizer, static spatial audio, and personalized sound adjustment via the Nothing X app, you elevate your listening experience to a new level. The dual-chamber design guarantees crystal-clear highs and deep bass, supported by Hi-Res audio via LDAC codec. The interchangeable ear cushions are easy to swap out or clean – perfect for your personal style. Whether commuting, working from home, or during workouts: the Headphone Pro flexibly adapts to your needs. Thanks to Bluetooth 5.4 with dual connection, you can effortlessly switch between your laptop and smartphone, while five microphones ensure clear calls.
